node.label: Pelvic girdle amyotrophy
node.definition: Atrophy of the muscles of the pelvic girdle (also known as hip girdle), i.e., the gluteal muscles, the lateral rotators, the adductors, the psoas major and the iliacus muscle.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2A
